# betterado_feed_retention_policy (Resource)

Manages the retention policy for an Azure DevOps Artifacts feed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "Example Project"
}

resource "betterado_feed" "example" {
  name       = "example-feed"
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
}

resource "betterado_feed_retention_policy" "example" {
  project_id                                = betterado_project.example.id
  feed_id                                   = betterado_feed.example.id
  count_limit                               = 100
  days_to_keep_recently_downloaded_packages = 365
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `count_limit` (Number) The maximum number of versions per package to keep (1–5000).
- `days_to_keep_recently_downloaded_packages` (Number) The number of days to keep recently downloaded packages (1–4000).
- `feed_id` (String) The ID of the feed to set the retention policy on.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The project ID (UUID) for a project-scoped feed. Omit for org-scoped feeds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The feed ID (same as feed_id), used as the resource identifier.
